research_question: For the v0.2.0 frozen Gilbert 3:1:1 trefoil candidate, is a full distributed-vorticity 3-D incompressible Euler relative equilibrium found and spatially/time/finite-core qualified, without changing the initial candidate between search and pilot?
objective: P1 frozen same-seed handoff; P2 full-field rigid-motion residual in Euler omega; P3 temporal/spatial/finite-core convergence only. No physical stability, force-limit or gravitational claims in v0.3.0.
null_hypothesis: H0: the pinned candidate fails to exhibit a discretization-qualified full-field relative equilibrium within the specified resolution range (residual > 0.05).
alternative_hypothesis: H1: the pinned candidate has full-field relative-equilibrium residual <= 0.05 and numerical convergence on spatially well resolved cores and nonlocal gaps.
assumptions: Incompressible inviscid periodic Euler, constant density, no body forcing in P1-P3
Finite-width vorticity generated from periodicized compact C2 tube convolution and solenoidal Fourier projection; periodic image and de-aliasing artifacts documented
Gilbert 3:1:1 seed and v0.2.0 candidate immutable for this study; model units are SI but not canonical SST physical scales
Rigid rotation is not globally periodic on a periodic cube: fitted rotating frame is a local diagnostic, not a certified global relative equilibrium
No stability / load-to-failure tests, no GR or c4/G target in blind code
Two genuinely executed independent backends required by Framework 1.1.0; pure Python only is diagnostic

equations.dimensional_check: All momentum terms in m s^-2

equations.purpose: six parameter full field relative equilibrium fit
equations.dimensional_check: Numerator and denominator s^-2 m^3/2, ratio dimensionless

equations.purpose: energy conservation of unforced Euler and temporal convergence
equations.dimensional_check: E in kg m^2 s^-2, drift dimensionless

observables.definition: same seed + selection + input SHA-256 and finite core gap at all grids
full Euler distributed vorticity rotating/translating relative frame residual
spatial, temporal and finite-core grid discrepancy for fixed final T

steps.operation: load pinned exact v0.2 selection and original Gilbert trefoil geometry, verify hashes at each grid and avoid re-optimizing on validation grids
construct divergence-free finite width vorticity and projected Euler RHS and solve 6-parameter least squares for full-field stationarity
evolve unforced Euler to fixed absolute time 0.1s using CFL-limited RK4 on ascending resolutions; independent dt halving at n48

falsification_criteria.criterion: No full-field R<=0.05 in admissible core+gap-resolved grids, within pinned candidate
Core radius <8 cells or nonlocal free gap <3 cells
Only one of Python/C++/GPU executed genuine numerical implementation

edge_cases: Initial vorticity Fourier projection has noncompact tails
Numerical continuity of nonlinear Euler is not proven by a small divergence residual
Rigid rotation not a periodic symmetry of this cube
Topological fidelity not checked by material markers alone
Near-contact gaps smaller than one grid cell
No arbitrary source data rerandomization after v0.2 selection
predictions: If a solution exists within this specific geometry, full-field residual will decrease to <= 5% on resolved grids
If no equilibrium at pinned parameters, high residual persists as resolution improves; other geometries remain open
